cards.w1_start: The last golden frog sleeps in a tangled pond. Its friends are stuck around it. Guide them home, one gentle hop at a time.
cards.w1_end: The mist lifts. The pond remembers how to breathe. But the golden frog’s luck is needed in the marsh beyond.
cards.w2_start: Lanterns flicker in the marsh. Snakes sleep here, so wake none. Turn the pads carefully, and every frog will find its way.
cards.w2_end: The last lantern glows. Nothing was hurt, nothing was rushed. Only patience was needed.
cards.final: The golden frog wakes. Wherever a pond is cared for, luck returns. The pond blooms.
